svg.title: catalunya-2023 authentic F1 circuit outline
svg.desc: Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2023_F1_CourseLayout_Spain.svg; creator: ごひょううべこ; license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). PitPitch adaptation: isolate exact original route path, omit all labels, numbers, pit lanes, sector colours and background, recolour black and crop empty margin. Derivative distributed under CC-BY-SA-4.0. Original SHA-256: 08e92c70d1f3955600a287a8a7566c83aabe887cc3d1bec37189a62c12989c81.
Authentic source transforms applied; proportionally sampled route with subpixel curve tolerance; uniform black double contour with transparent center and background; no labels.
